scope: Independent local review of the user-invoked, one-attempt L40S diagnostic screen controller and remote helper.

validation.evidence_scope: All lifecycle/API behavior was mocked. The remote-runner test used synthetic archives and mocked runtime, plan validation, and subprocess stages; it did not load pretrained weights or access a GPU.

contracts_reviewed.attempt: Dry-run is default; only explicit --run enters one create attempt. POST is never automatically repeated after transport ambiguity or rejection.
contracts_reviewed.account_safety: Pod listing requires the documented v2 pagination envelope and an unpaginated result; any existing account pod stops before create. Teardown checks exact attempt name, pinned image, L40S, and existing network-volume mount before deleting the disposable pod.
contracts_reviewed.storage: The existing 50GB STANDARD volume k6u810gze3 in US-MO-1 is mounted and retained. The controller has no volume-create or volume-delete call.
contracts_reviewed.limits: One attempt is bounded by 1800 seconds and a $0.75 working cap, counting create, bootstrap, staging, model loading, validation, failure, retrieval, and shutdown. A local guard is armed before POST; no provider hard-TTL guarantee is claimed.
contracts_reviewed.identity: Candidate archive sizes and SHA-256 values, protected local sources, the executed remote helper, implementation identity, current L40S request, pinned runtime, and both sealed technical plans are checked before model work.
contracts_reviewed.cost_and_host: Catalog and actual pod rates must be finite and <=$1.09/h. The actual v2 Pod GpuConfig.memory is system RAM; the captured schema says 'Total system RAM in GB allocated to the pod across all requested GPUs.' It is checked at >=64GB. Catalog GPU memory remains a separate 48GB VRAM value.
contracts_reviewed.storage_cost_evidence: $0.02/h is a conservative planning allowance based on published disk and STANDARD-volume rates; it is not an account-specific invoice or all-in quote. The remaining margin must be checked against actual billing after the user-run attempt.
contracts_reviewed.logs: Timestamped controller events, child output, bootstrap output, periodic stage heartbeats, downloaded-byte estimates, GPU telemetry samples, per-stage logs, runner status, validation progress, and final receipt are persisted. The test confirms child output is stored once.
contracts_reviewed.secrets: The persisted request contains the public SSH key needed for access, but no private SSH key, RunPod API key, AWS secret, or R2 credential. The API token is passed to curl through stdin rather than command arguments or saved files.
contracts_reviewed.scientific_claim: The screen remains diagnostic only and its receipt explicitly does not authorize scientific collection. Frozen tolerances and experiment settings are checked unchanged.

issues_found_and_resolved.issue: Remote extraction originally attempted to create an already-existing plans destination.
issues_found_and_resolved.resolution: The helper now extracts the screen archive into a fresh plans root; a synthetic sealed-archive integration test covers both contexts and receipt creation.

issues_found_and_resolved.issue: The separately uploaded remote helper could otherwise differ from the helper in the sealed source archive.
issues_found_and_resolved.resolution: The local controller rehashes before SCP and the remote helper checks its own SHA-256 against the candidate identity before extraction or model work. Positive and negative cases are tested.

issues_found_and_resolved.issue: An incomplete pod-list response could be mistaken for an empty account.
issues_found_and_resolved.resolution: Preflight now requires the documented hasNextPage/nextCursor fields and rejects missing or paginated evidence; malformed-envelope cases are tested.

issues_found_and_resolved.issue: An uncertain create response with no visible pod could be incorrectly recorded as clean teardown.
issues_found_and_resolved.resolution: The attempt remains guarded without a confirmed-cleanup marker. A known HTTP rejection and an ambiguous timeout are tested separately.

remaining_limits: No pod has been created and no paid work has run.
GPU availability, actual host allocation, CUDA visibility, model download, L40S memory fit, numerical agreement, benchmark duration, and final all-in billing remain unmeasured.
A synthetic passing receipt validates control flow only; it is not pretrained-model or hardware evidence.
